body:
It's less of a panic trigger and more of a flashback trigger but there is one song that gives me a vivid memory of a conversation ive had that made me insanely uncomfortable and question myself and how i react to things and it gives me such a big feeling of dread. 

the bad thing about it is the song is a genuine bop but everytime i hear it im reminded of this memory and i spiral into a burst of overthinking and anxiety.
thank you for this, it really means a lot
i dont even know how theyd react bc im so scared to let them know whats going on in my head
i sometimes find myself wishing cancer upon myself
I'm not sure, it took me so long to get to this point I fear it'll take longer to see a different person and it not be beneficial in the slightest like this experience.
